info.name: Robot rollout verifier Archive Ingest API

items.docs:
One live take from the phone: verify it and push it onto the feed.

Blocks for the ~1-3s of frame sampling + h1 so the recorder sees the
verdict in hand; the feed entry is appended BEFORE we return, so the big
screen never depends on the phone's connection surviving the response.
Error results are fed too — a failed take should show on screen, not
vanish silently.
